sql_templates.description: Select latest insider alerts and bulk/block deals with technical scores.
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_insider_alerts AS (
    SELECT symbol, MAX(alert_date) AS latest_alert_date
    FROM signals.insider_alerts
    WHERE alert_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
    GROUP BY symbol
), latest_bulk_deals AS (
    SELECT symbol, MAX(deal_date) AS latest_deal_date
    FROM signals.bulk_block_deals
    WHERE deal_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
    GROUP BY symbol
), latest_technicals AS (
    SELECT symbol, snapshot_date, stage_score, technical_score
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
)
SELECT ia.symbol, ia.latest_alert_date, bd.latest_deal_date, ss.stage_score, ss.technical_score
FROM latest_insider_alerts ia
JOIN latest_bulk_deals bd ON ia.symbol = bd.symbol
JOIN latest_technicals ss ON ia.symbol = ss.symbol
WHERE ss.technical_score > 0
ORDER BY ss.technical_score DESC
LIMIT 10;
